name: colophon
title_zh: 目录一丢就生成网址，改完原地更新、收回权限也随时
tagline_zh: 做完 HTML、报告、图表、幻灯片，不用再找网盘或临时服务器。把整个目录变成链接，改文件即刷新，设密码限访问。
tagline_en: Done with HTML, reports, charts, decks? No more zip-and-upload. Turn the folder into a URL, edit-and-refresh.
desc_en: Use when you have produced HTML, a report, a chart, a slide deck or any directory of files and the person needs a URL for it — publishes a directory to the web, updates it in place, controls who can see it, and takes it down again.
why_zh: 它把「发布」做成目录的原地操作，不是上传快照。改一个文件，线上同步变；权限和下线都对着同一份目录管。
why_en: It treats publishing as an in-place operation on the folder, not a snapshot upload. Edit one file, the live URL updates; access.
limit_zh: 只发布静态目录，不含数据库或服务端逻辑；需要本机能跑 Node 且目录可被持续监听。下线是删链接不是删文件。
limit_en: Static folders only—no DB or server logic. Needs Node running and the folder watchable. Takedown removes the link, not files; external edits to the.
title_en: Publish any folder to a live URL, update in place, revoke.
